H1_synthetic_data_fidelity.headline: H1 (QGAN FID lower): INCONCLUSIVE (exploratory) -- observed QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM, p=0.540.
why: observed direction: QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM; hypothesis expects: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM
single QGAN-LLM run = 133.2; Classical GAN-LLM mean = 121.8 (sd 15.5, n=5)
blockers: QGAN-LLM has only 1 run (two-sample test impossible)

H2_adversarial_resilience.headline: H2 (entanglement vs ASR): INCONCLUSIVE (exploratory) -- r=-0.15, p=0.602, n=14.
why: hypothesis expects r < 0; observed r < 0
CI contains 0: the data are compatible with no relationship at all
~335 points would give 80% power if the true r equals the observed 0.15; 30 points if the true r is 0.5
equivalence (r): 90% CI of r [-0.57, 0.33] vs +/-0.3 -> not shown (p_TOST = 0.303)
blockers: thinnest sweep level has only 2 runs (< 3); per-level spread cannot be estimated
H2_adversarial_resilience.next_action: Collect >= 30 independent runs spanning entanglement levels (vary seed AND entanglement setting).
